title: 131 ## X VICTIMS OF RAPE The statistics of victims of rape were collected under three age groups viz. below 16 years, between 16 to 30 years and above 30 years. The highest number of cases reported was noticed in U. P. (741) out of (2,917) total cases followed by M. P. (493) and West Bengal (300). The percentage of victims of rape under age group 16 to 30 years was the highest (58.4 percent) while girls below the age of 16 years accounted for (26.8 percent) followed by the age group or above 30 years (14.8 percent). The relevant statistics are furnished in Table 55.
